scope: Isolates the main-machine/Strix IQ2_XS artifact difference and validates an opt-in double-precision derived-weight patch against one identical 640-row expert. This receipt does not claim reproducibility for other i-quant types or a full rerun of the 66,649,935,616-byte model.

checks.name: whole-artifact-and-tensor-plan
checks.result: Both artifacts have the same size and tensor-type plan; all 48 ffn_down_exps Q2_0 tensors match, while all 96 IQ2_XS gate/up tensors differ across every layer.
checks.conclusion: The difference is IQ2_XS quantization, not GGUF layout, Q2_0, copying, or scheduling.

checks.name: controlled-layer-0-gate-expert-0
checks.result: Raw IQ4_XS source bytes and the exact 2560-value iMatrix slice are identical on both hosts. IQ4_XS dequantized floats and block variances are bit-identical. Repeated original quantization is deterministic per host: main be823537fd0a7281ed37052a28a944cba6238cffbce54edb508fab728d07e95f, Strix fc2e17a84233464f7ce23c077c77f7fa9e60a3fbb6220292b367421e86eb3902.

checks.name: cross-host-output-extent
checks.result: The original one-expert outputs differ in 573 output bytes, 323 of 6400 IQ2_XS blocks, and 257 of 640 rows.

checks.name: derived-weight-divergence
checks.result: Before codebook selection, w bits differ in 296376/1638400 values (18.09%) and qw*w in 257713/1638400 (15.73%), while sigma2 blocks match. Strix GCC -O0 and -ffp-contract=off preserve fc2e17...; -ffast-math produces another result. The float add/multiply/square-root expression, not block variance or parallel scheduling, is the origin.

checks.name: patched-cross-host-hash
checks.result: Apple Clang and Strix GCC both produced e5b46bc8dbee76ad6c6975755436c77ee55be859b9d08f2d4fa9a4c0c19ffe2a. The quantizer and probe were compiled with -ffp-contract=off.

checks.name: opt-in-setup-contract
checks.result: 3 tests passed: no patch without STRATA_DETERMINISTIC_IQ=1, idempotent patch with the gate, and loud refusal when the upstream expression moves.

non_claims: The full 66.65 GB model was not requantized again with the opt-in patch.
The patch is not a default installer or engine behavior and does not change the pinned llama.cpp source without STRATA_DETERMINISTIC_IQ=1.
The patch does not establish perplexity, output quality, or throughput superiority for the 3.01-BPW mix.
Other IQ formats with similar derived-weight expressions were not proven deterministic.
The setup tests prove patch application and refusal behavior, not compilation of llama-quantize in every installer matrix.
